purpose: Judge preservation of the person, pose, scene, and composition under an authentic 2002–05 digicam look: direct flash, blown highlights, soft focus, low-end CCD noise, dated color, bloom, and candid imperfection.

examples.title: Make the visual recipe clear in one glance
whyItWorks: The native cover makes the nostalgic camera language immediate
The flash-blown group photo establishes the imperfect digital finish
It remains a source-native hero rather than a fabricated Wiggly composition

examples.title: Make flash turn a dinner into a memory
whyItWorks: One baked original inset makes source preservation inspectable
Harsh flash, motion softness, and noise keep the candid scene believable
The result feels amateur and alive rather than cleanly editorial

examples.title: Let the light wash the frame
whyItWorks: The inset preserves both people and the ocean-side pose

The softness is visible without losing the people

examples.title: Give a subway snapshot real CCD character
